Free tools and software !

Free tools and software I build in my spare time: no ads, no account. Some tools work directly in the browser, while others can be downloaded. And more are coming soon: video, VFX, photography, writing, drawing, … If a tool helps you, you can buy me a coffee on the support page. Sharing or leaving a quick comment on Instagram also helps me a lot !

The tools

Each tool has its own page, instructions and version history. Everything is free.

AudioSUITE by FlorindoLAB

NewSoundVSTPluginmacOSWindows

26 free audio plug-ins and a rack to mix, measure and shape sound, from EQ to tuner. Available as VST3, Audio Unit and standalone apps, for Windows and macOS (Intel and Silicon).
